title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection, typically served with a side of rice or flatbread.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together vegetable oil, garlic, lemon juice, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or mint, if desired.
